author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: Canonical suffered its second DDoS attack this year, disrupting public websites for over four hours while Launchpad and the Snap Store remained online. title: Canonical Hit by Second DDoS Attack in 2026, Public Websites Disrupted

author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: Attackers are exploiting SonicWall SMA 1000 vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-102255 (CVSS score of 10.0), just days after its public disclosure. Attackers have begun exploiting a critical flaw in SonicWall SMA 1000 appliances, tracked as CVE-2026-102255 (CVSS score of 10.0), just days after public disclosure. The vulnerability is a server-side request forgery (SSRF) flaw that requires no login. […]
title: SonicWall Patches CVSS 10.0 SSRF Flaw as Attacks Begin

author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: CyberXero used 51 AI agents to support cyberattacks, stealing 628,000 Ukrainian records, including sensitive data from energy infrastructure. title: CyberXero Used 51 AI Agents to Steal 628,000 Ukrainian Records
